LEARN MORE ABOUT US THE PROCESS OUR 4-STEP DEPLOYMENT PROCESS We don’t drag our feet—and we don’t waste your time. Our process is streamlined to identify top talent, validate technical firepower, and deploy with purpose. From first call to client deployment, we move with intent. You’ll know where you stand—every step of the way. STEP 1 HR INTERVIEW: MISSION ALIGNMENT CHECK A focused conversation to understand your experience, mindset, and alignment with our high-performance culture. We're looking for grit, initiative, and clarity of purpose. STEP 2 TECHNICAL INTERVIEW: CAPABILITY ASSESSMENT​ You’ll meet with our technical leads to test your SAP expertise, situational thinking, and problem-solving under pressure. You will work closely with SAP account teams, industry partners, and internal solution leads to identify where we can bring value, support client priorities, and shape opportunities for collaboration. You will help guide clients through understanding our capabilities, co-developing engagement approaches, and ensuring alignment between business needs and our delivery strengths. This role is perfect for those who love the thrill of the chase whilst putting client success at the heart of everything you do. We are seeking for a self-starter, a go-getter, energetic and dynamic Account Executive. Key responsibilities include: Develop and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients. Identify, manage, and qualify a list of target accounts to generate opportunities to pursue and close. Qualify, progress, and accelerate opportunities from Marketing and partners. THE CHALLENGE The client was operating on a fragmented technology landscape, with 140 legacy applications—many custom-built—featuring overlapping functionality and siloed data. This led to high operating costs due to licence duplication, infrastructure sprawl, and vendor complexity, as well as inconsistent business processes across departments that slowed decision-making and increased compliance risks. Previous attempts to rationalise the environment had stalled because of conflicting stakeholder priorities, the absence of a clear migration pathway, and concerns over operational disruption during consolidation. Defined target capabilities to be delivered on the unified platform. STAGE 3 Platform Selection & Migration Roadmap Facilitated vendor-neutral platform evaluation. Developed a phased migration plan balancing quick wins with high-value transformations. STAGE 4 Change Enablement & Execution Coordinated cross-functional teams to execute migrations with minimal disruption. Delivered targeted training and adoption support to embed the new platform. RESULT 134 legacy applications retired — reducing licensing, hosting, and support costs by millions annually. One unified platform deployed, improving cross-department data sharing and reporting accuracy. Business processes standardised, reducing cycle times and enhancing compliance. Stakeholder alignment achieved, enabling faster decision-making and future transformation readiness. WHY IT MATTERS Application sprawl silently drains budgets and slows business. Maintain Technology’s structured, business-led approach ensures that consolidation isn’t just a technical exercise — it’s a functional transformation that unlocks efficiency, agility, and long-term value. Defined a phased roadmap to replace ageing systems, standardise processes, and embed data-driven decision-making. Stakeholder Engagement Rebuilt — Operational, IT, and executive teams aligned behind a shared transformation plan. WHY IT MATTERS Many asset-intensive organisations are caught between ageing technology and the promise of digital transformation. Structured knowledge transfer sessions and shadow-support periods to safeguard quality. RESULT 50% reduction in delivery costs across project and application maintenance functions. No drop in performance — all SLA and KPI targets maintained during and after transition. Sustainable onshore–offshore capability with embedded governance and continuous improvement processes. Proven repeatable model for future offshoring without the pitfalls seen in prior attempts. WHY IT MATTERS Offshoring is not a cost-saving silver bullet — it can fail without the right model. localStats.text: Skip to content About Capabilities Talent Solutions Insights Contact IMPROVED GO-LIVE QUALITY WITH ASSURED TESTING STANDARDS How Maintain Technology Reduced Defects and Increased Go-Live Confidence Through Structured Testing Assurance INDUSTRY Enterprise IT / Digital Transformation ENGAGEMENT Testing Governance & Quality Assurance Uplift OUTCOME Significant reduction in post-go-live defects, smoother cutovers, and improved stakeholder confidence. THE CHALLENGE The client’s projects were plagued by poor quality assurance processes that resulted in high defect counts in production, stressful go-lives requiring emergency fixes, and extended post-implementation support. With no consistent testing methodology in place, quality standards varied widely between vendors and teams. This led to reduced user trust, higher rework costs, and unpredictable delivery timelines. OUR APPROACH: ASSURED TESTING STANDARDS Maintain Technology implemented a testing assurance methodology to make quality a non-negotiable part of delivery: STEP 1 Quality Baseline Assessment Reviewed past releases to identify defect trends, root causes, and test coverage gaps. Mapped testing practices across teams and vendors to understand inconsistencies. STEP 2 Testing Standards Framework Defined a standard test planning, execution, and acceptance process applicable across all projects. Embedded entry/exit criteria for every stage of testing (system, integration, UAT, regression). STEP 3 Independent Testing Assurance Introduced an independent QA oversight role to validate coverage, completeness, and traceability. Ensured test cases linked directly to business requirements and acceptance criteria. STEP 4 Defect Prevention & Early Detection Shifted testing earlier in the cycle (“shift-left” approach). Introduced automated regression tests for high-risk areas. RESULT Defects in production reduced by 65% compared to prior releases. Zero critical defects at go-live for the first time in program history. Stakeholder confidence increased — leadership had visibility of quality readiness before cutover. Repeatable quality governance model implemented across future projects. WHY IT MATTERS In complex IT programs, go-live quality is the difference between a smooth transition and a costly, reputation-damaging failure. Maintain Technology’s assured testing standards give leaders confidence that what’s going live is what was promised — working as intended, from day one. WANT YOUR NEXT GO-LIVE TO BE A NON-EVENT? If you're ready to tackle Australia’s most complex enterprise programs and lead from the front, we have a role for you. THE MAINTAIN DIFFERENCE WHY JOIN US Maintain Technology is a specialist enterprise systems and technology consulting firm trusted by Australia’s most critical industries, including government, mining and defence. We find strategists, architects, operators and problem-solvers and connect them with Australia’s leading enterprises to transform mission-critical projects. LEARN MORE ABOUT US THE PROCESS OUR 4-STEP DEPLOYMENT PROCESS We don’t drag our feet—and we don’t waste your time. Our process is streamlined to identify top talent, validate technical firepower, and deploy with purpose. From first call to client deployment, we move with intent. You’ll know where you stand—every step of the way. STEP 1 HR INTERVIEW: MISSION ALIGNMENT CHECK A focused conversation to understand your experience, mindset, and alignment with our high-performance culture. We're looking for grit, initiative, and clarity of purpose. STEP 2 TECHNICAL INTERVIEW: CAPABILITY ASSESSMENT​ You’ll meet with our technical leads to test your SAP expertise, situational thinking, and problem-solving under pressure. This is where skills meet mission-readiness. STEP 3 CLIENT PROFILE SUBMISSION: STRATEGIC MATCHMAKING​ Once cleared internally, we build a tailored profile to match your capabilities to mission-critical client needs across S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Asset Management and more. STEP 4 CLIENT INTERVIEW: FINAL FIT & DEPLOYMENT​ You’ll meet directly with the client to ensure project alignment and team chemistry. When it’s a match, we deploy fast—with full support from our command centre.​ AVAILABLE JOBS EXPLORE OUR OPEN ROLES VIEW ALL JOBS Remote Job (3) Job Type Contract (6) Full time (3) Account Executive Remote Job What You'll Do In this high-profile sales, growth and expansion Account Executive role, you will focus on driving growth by building meaningful relationships across our client network and the broader SAP ecosystem. You will work closely with SAP account teams, industry partners, and internal solution leads to identify where we can bring value, support client priorities, and shape opportunities for collaboration. You will help guide clients through understanding our capabilities, co-developing engagement approaches, and ensuring alignment between business needs and our delivery strengths. This role is perfect for those who love the thrill of the chase whilst putting client success at the heart of everything you do. We are seeking for a self-starter, a go-getter, energetic and dynamic Account Executive. Key responsibilities include: Develop and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients. Identify, manage, and qualify a list of target accounts to generate opportunities to pursue and close. Qualify, progress, and accelerate opportunities from Marketing and partners. Collaborate with SAP and partner ecosystem teams to identify, qualify, manage and close sales opportunities. Engage with client stakeholders (including the C-Level) to understand strategic priorities and challenges. Support the shaping of proposals and engagement approaches aligned to client objectives and outcomes. Coordinate internal teams to ensure cohesive positioning and delivery readiness - you advocate for your clients inside Maintain. Maintain CRM discipline and contribute to account and territory planning, forecasting and opportunity management, and data/general account management activities. Requirements What You Bring 5–8+ years' experience in selling and account managing SAP services, business development, account management, presales, or consulting. Strong understanding of SAP solutions (SAP Cloud ERP, BDC, BTP, HXM, DSC, Intelligent Spend, CX, etc) and services offerings (e.g., S/4HANA implementations, upgrades, support, optimisation). Ability to build trust and engage stakeholders at multiple levels, including the C-level. Guide discussions that connect business priorities to SAP service capabilities. Collaborative mindset and experience working with SAP partners or consulting teams. Nice to Have Identify, develop, and present business cases for client presentations. Exposure to presales, solution advisory, or value engineering. Familiarity with SAP account team structures and partner co-sell models. Benefits About Maintain Technology Maintain Technology Consulting is one of the fastest growing and most exciting SAP and Enterprise Applications players in the market today. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Brisbane, we serve clients throughout Australia and have a high focus on Delivery Excellence, Assurance and delivering high risk / high impact ERP and Enterprise Transformation Programs. We are proud of our High Performance culture and see it as our differentiator in how we engage and deliver. We do this by putting our clients front and centre, and collaborate with industry leaders to meet the challenges and opportunities of our clients each and every day. Join our team today - we are moving mountains every day. 02/25/2026 Contract Estimator/ Quantity Surveyor Remote Job Work on Australian construction projects without leaving the Philippines. Maintain Technology is looking for an experienced Estimator/ Quantity Surveyor to help review and validate trade quotes across residential construction projects in Australia. This is a fully remote role where you’ll apply your expertise in construction estimating, quantity take-offs, and trade scope analysis while working with a modern digital quoting platform. If you have experience in cost estimation, subcontractor pricing review, or quantity surveying and want exposure to international construction standards and projects, this role offers a unique opportunity to combine your technical expertise with a fast-growing technology platform. Requirements 5+ years experience in construction estimating or quantity surveying Experience working on residential construction projects Experience reviewing subcontractor quotes or trade tenders Strong understanding of trade packages and construction cost structures Qualifications Preferred qualifications include: Experience working with Australian, US, UK, or international construction projects Experience in outsourced estimating or offshore construction support teams Familiarity with metric and imperial measurements Understanding of trade packages and subcontractor pricing Professional certifications (advantageous but not required): Licensed Civil Engineer (PRC) Cost Engineering or Construction Estimating certifications Training in Quantity Take-Off (QTO), construction estimating, or project costing Australian Institute of Quantity Surveyors (AIQS) Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) Benefits Work on International Construction Projects: Gain exposure to Australian residential construction projects, working with real trade scopes, pricing structures, and industry standards. High Ownership & Impact: Play a key role in building the cost validation and quoting framework behind the platform. Your expertise will directly influence how trade quotes are reviewed, benchmarked, and approved. Remote Work Flexibility: This is a 100% remote role, allowing you to work from home while collaborating with an international team. Working hours are aligned with Australian business hours, but we focus on output and results rather than strict clock-watching. 03/10/2026 Full time Senior Full Stack Developer Remote Job As our Senior Full Stack Developer, you're the entire engineering function. You'll build the product from the ground up — designing the architecture, writing the code, wiring the automation, and integrating the AI layer that turns a photo of a job site into a professional, accurate quote. No one is ahead of you technically. No existing codebase to inherit. You're setting the standard the future team builds on. Key Responsibilities Architect and build the end-to-end quoting platform — from photo intake via Tally through AI-generated quote creation, QS review workflow, and Stripe deposit collection Own the AI integration layer — engineer and iterate the Claude API prompt architecture that transforms unstructured job inputs (photos, trade type, scope notes) into structured, client-ready quotes reliably and at scale Build and maintain Make.com automation workflows that orchestrate the full pipeline — handling routing logic, error states, retries, and progressive automation as AI accuracy improves Develop the data layer in Airtable — relational structures, QS review interfaces, feedback capture, and the correction loops that improve AI output over time Integrate Stripe for payment flows — deposit link generation, webhook handling, and confirmation logic baked into the quote delivery workflow Connect and maintain the full toolchain — Tally, Zoho CRM, Google Docs, Zeely.ai, and Canva assets into a coherent system that runs reliably at low operational cost Build quote template and job-type logic — enabling fast template assignment today and progressive AI-driven automation of that process as confidence grows Instrument the pipeline for visibility and resilience — logging, alerting, and error handling so the team always knows pipeline status without digging through five tools Write clean documentation — the architecture, integrations, and decisions you make will be inherited by the engineers you'll eventually lead Reduce manual overhead over time — you're not just building v1, you're designing toward a pipeline that increasingly runs itself Requirements 6+ years of full stack development experience, you've designed, built, and shipped production applications end-to-end, not just contributed to parts of them. Strong proficiency in at least one modern backend language — Node.js, Python, or similar for custom integrations, API work, and logic that goes beyond what no-code tools can handle. Frontend competency in React or equivalent — enough to build lightweight internal interfaces, quote previews, or client-facing touchpoints as needed. Hands-on Make.com or n8n experience at a production level — multi-step, branching, error-handled workflows on real data, not tutorial projects. Practical experience engineering LLM API integrations — prompt design, structured output handling, reliability at scale, and iterative improvement based on real-world feedback (Claude or GPT). Proven ability to design and use Airtable as an operational data layer — not just as a spreadsheet, but as a structured backend with automations, relational fields, and form connected workflows. Stripe API integration experience — payment links, webhooks, confirmation handling. Comfort designing complete system architecture from scratch. Ability to work autonomously in low-process environments. Benefits High-Impact Ownership: You will have the autonomy to design and deploy functional systems from scratch. THE CHALLENGE A major transformation program had come to a standstill as two key delivery partners became embroiled in a dispute over contract terms, milestone payments, and scope interpretation. The relationship had deteriorated, deadlines were slipping, and both sides were preparing for a prolonged legal battle. OUR APPROACH: THE CONTRACT MEDIATION METHODOLOGY Maintain Technology deployed its 4-phase rapid mediation framework, designed for high-stakes IT delivery disputes: DAYS 1–2 Rapid Discovery Confidential interviews with both parties and a deep-dive review of all contractual documents. DAYS 3–4 Gap Analysis Clear mapping of issues into immediate blockers, negotiable points, and future-phase considerations. DAYS 8–10 Facilitated Agreement A structured joint mediation session leading to a signed contract addendum and a restart plan. RESULT Deadlock resolved in 10 days without legal escalation. Revised contract signed with clarified scope, updated milestones, and balanced risk allocation. Delivery teams were back in motion within 3 business days of the agreement. The commercial relationship was stabilised, protecting program outcomes and avoiding millions in potential delay costs. WHY IT MATTERS In complex IT programs, every week of delay compounds risk and cost. Maintain Technology’s mediation approach is built to resolve disputes quickly, preserve relationships, and keep delivery on track — without sacrificing commercial fairness. localStats.text: Skip to content FROM 140 LEGACY APPS TO ONE UNIFIED PLATFORM How Maintain Technology Drove Functional Transformation and Platform Consolidation Across a Complex Enterprise INDUSTRY Public Sector / Asset-Intensive Enterprise ENGAGEMENT Functional Transformation & Platform Consolidation OUTCOME 140 legacy applications retired, one unified platform deployed, and functional processes streamlined enterprise-wide. THE CHALLENGE The client was operating on a fragmented technology landscape, with 140 legacy applications—many custom-built—featuring overlapping functionality and siloed data. This led to high operating costs due to licence duplication, infrastructure sprawl, and vendor complexity, as well as inconsistent business processes across departments that slowed decision-making and increased compliance risks. Previous attempts to rationalise the environment had stalled because of conflicting stakeholder priorities, the absence of a clear migration pathway, and concerns over operational disruption during consolidation. OUR APPROACH: THE MAINTAIN TECHNOLOGY TRANSFORMATION & CONSOLIDATION FRAMEWORK We deployed a four-stage enterprise transformation method: STAGE 1 Rapid Assessment & Application Mapping Inventoried all 140 applications, documenting ownership, usage, dependencies, and business criticality. Mapped functional overlaps and identified candidates for consolidation or retirement. STAGE 2 Future-State Process Design Engaged functional leads to design standardised, best-practice processes. Defined target capabilities to be delivered on the unified platform. STAGE 3 Platform Selection & Migration Roadmap Facilitated vendor-neutral platform evaluation. Developed a phased migration plan balancing quick wins with high-value transformations. STAGE 4 Change Enablement & Execution Coordinated cross-functional teams to execute migrations with minimal disruption. Delivered targeted training and adoption support to embed the new platform. RESULT 134 legacy applications retired — reducing licensing, hosting, and support costs by millions annually. One unified platform deployed, improving cross-department data sharing and reporting accuracy. Business processes standardised, reducing cycle times and enhancing compliance. Stakeholder alignment achieved, enabling faster decision-making and future transformation readiness. WHY IT MATTERS Application sprawl silently drains budgets and slows business. Maintain Technology’s structured, business-led approach ensures that consolidation isn’t just a technical exercise — it’s a functional transformation that unlocks efficiency, agility, and long-term value. localStats.text: Skip to content CUT DELIVERY COSTS BY 50% THROUGH OFFSHORE TRANSITION How Maintain Technology Optimised the Onshore–Offshore Model to Deliver Sustainable Cost Savings Without Compromising Performance INDUSTRY Enterprise IT / Application Management ENGAGEMENT Outsourcing & Delivery Model Optimisation OUTCOME 50% reduction in delivery costs, maintained service targets, and a stable long-term onshore–offshore capability. THE CHALLENGE The client was facing high project and application maintenance costs that consumed a significant portion of the budget and limited investment in innovation. Their delivery model was inefficient, heavily reliant on high-cost onshore resources, and previous attempts at offshoring had failed—cost savings were negated by delivery issues, quality degradation, and missed targets. The leadership team therefore needed a solution that could reduce costs sustainably without repeating the mistakes of earlier offshore transitions. OUR APPROACH: THE MAINTAIN TECHNOLOGY OUTSOURCING METHODOLOGY We deployed a structured, capability-first model to ensure offshoring worked in practice — not just on paper: STEP 1 Baseline & Opportunity Assessment Analysed service catalogue, cost structures, delivery performance, and skill distribution. Identified functions and activities most suited for offshore delivery without impacting service targets. STEP 2 Capability Alignment Matched offshore partner capabilities to client requirements, focusing on technical skills, domain knowledge, and service quality history. Defined clear roles and accountability split between onshore and offshore teams. STEP 3 Optimised Onshore–Offshore Operating Model Designed governance and communication structures to bridge cultural and time-zone differences. Established joint KPIs to drive shared accountability. Embedded a “follow the sun” approach for faster turnaround and reduced downtime. STEP 4 Phased Transition & Knowledge Transfer Piloted with a subset of services before scaling. Structured knowledge transfer sessions and shadow-support periods to safeguard quality. RESULT 50% reduction in delivery costs across project and application maintenance functions. No drop in performance — all SLA and KPI targets maintained during and after transition. Sustainable onshore–offshore capability with embedded governance and continuous improvement processes. Proven repeatable model for future offshoring without the pitfalls seen in prior attempts. WHY IT MATTERS Offshoring is not a cost-saving silver bullet — it can fail without the right model. Maintain Technology’s outsourcing methodology ensures cost efficiency is balanced with capability, quality, and long-term sustainability, turning offshoring from a risk into a competitive advantage. localStats.text: Skip to content IMPROVED GO-LIVE QUALITY WITH ASSURED TESTING STANDARDS How Maintain Technology Reduced Defects and Increased Go-Live Confidence Through Structured Testing Assurance INDUSTRY Enterprise IT / Digital Transformation ENGAGEMENT Testing Governance & Quality Assurance Uplift OUTCOME Significant reduction in post-go-live defects, smoother cutovers, and improved stakeholder confidence. THE CHALLENGE The client’s projects were plagued by poor quality assurance processes that resulted in high defect counts in production, stressful go-lives requiring emergency fixes, and extended post-implementation support. With no consistent testing methodology in place, quality standards varied widely between vendors and teams. This led to reduced user trust, higher rework costs, and unpredictable delivery timelines. OUR APPROACH: ASSURED TESTING STANDARDS Maintain Technology implemented a testing assurance methodology to make quality a non-negotiable part of delivery: STEP 1 Quality Baseline Assessment Reviewed past releases to identify defect trends, root causes, and test coverage gaps. Mapped testing practices across teams and vendors to understand inconsistencies. STEP 2 Testing Standards Framework Defined a standard test planning, execution, and acceptance process applicable across all projects. Embedded entry/exit criteria for every stage of testing (system, integration, UAT, regression). STEP 3 Independent Testing Assurance Introduced an independent QA oversight role to validate coverage, completeness, and traceability. Ensured test cases linked directly to business requirements and acceptance criteria. STEP 4 Defect Prevention & Early Detection Shifted testing earlier in the cycle (“shift-left” approach). Introduced automated regression tests for high-risk areas. RESULT Defects in production reduced by 65% compared to prior releases. Zero critical defects at go-live for the first time in program history. Stakeholder confidence increased — leadership had visibility of quality readiness before cutover. Repeatable quality governance model implemented across future projects. WHY IT MATTERS In complex IT programs, go-live quality is the difference between a smooth transition and a costly, reputation-damaging failure. Maintain Technology’s assured testing standards give leaders confidence that what’s going live is what was promised — working as intended, from day one. WANT YOUR NEXT GO-LIVE TO BE A NON-EVENT?
